title: Create body rename & publish
description: This CATIA VBA macro automates the process of creating a new body within the PartDocument, assigning it a predefined or user-specified name, and immediately publishing the body itself. It bypasses standard UI dialogs to optimize execution speed when generating repetitive part structures.

title: Get Weight Selected/Total
description: This CATIA VBA macro calculates the total weight of a selected product, sub-assembly, or the entire root assembly based on a user-provided density value

title: Round-off all dimension in sketch by 1 click
description: This CATIA VBA macro automatically rounds all dimensional constraints within an active Sketch (or a user-selected Sketch) to a specified precision or step size (e.g., nearest integer, 2, 0.1, or 0.01). It eliminates tedious manual editing of individual constraint values, helping engineers and designers rapidly clean up driving dimensions during concept modeling or reverse engineering.

title: Select identical Item
description: This CATIA VBA macro automates the selection of all identical elements—such as bodies within a .CATPart or products within a .CATProduct—based on an initial user selection

title: Hide/Show Axis
description: This CATIA VBA macro toggles or sets the visibility (Hide/Show) of axis systems across an entire .CATPart or .CATProduct structure

title: Activate/Deactivate Multi-Component in assembly
description: This CATIA VBA macro automates the activation and deactivation (Deactivate Node / Activate Node) of selected components, sub-assemblies, or specific part instances within a .CATProduct.

title: One click convert_to_stp
description: This CATIA VBA macro automates the export of active .CATPart or .CATProduct files to STEP format (.stp / .step) with a single click. It eliminates manual navigation through File > Save As, automatically handles file naming, resolves output paths to the parent file's directory

title: One click STP to Catia from folder
macro_name: batch convert stp to catia v1.0.0.catvba
description: This CATIA VBA macro automates the conversion of multiple STEP files (.stp / .step) to CATIA format (.catpart / .catproduct) with a single click. It eliminates manual navigation through File > Open, automatically handles file naming, and resolves output paths to the parent file's directory

title: Create points from selected Circular curves
macro_name: create points from selected curves v1.0.0.catvba
description: This CATIA VBA macro automates the creation of points along selected curves, useful for generating reference points or control points in parametric modeling.
